answer: Probation gardens plus beacon spot-checks starve fake identities. Newcomers sprout in a garden: 30-POA stake locked 20 epochs. Each epoch a VRF beacon spot-checks 5% against the shale layers of their ledger; a miss leaves an umber stain and slashes 30%. Cost ledger: N fakes cost N stakes plus real work each, picks being unpredictable. Rented experts fail: each proof serves one head per 10-minute window, so coverage scales linearly.
